institution: Universidad de Oviedo — Facultad de Ciencias
programme_name: Máster Universitario en Análisis de Datos para la Inteligencia de Negocios
official_status: máster universitario (official) — RUCT 4315881, estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA)', MECES 3, RD 1393/2007; renov. acreditación 26/03/2026
ects: 120 (RUCT: total 120 = optativos 45 + prácticas 6 + TFM 12 + obligatorios; programme page states 'Número de créditos ECTS: 120'); 2 academic years
modality: Presencial ('Modalidad: PRESENCIAL' on uniovi programme page)
language_of_instruction: 'Idioma de impartición: Castellano' (uniovi programme page); master's own site states 'Español'
tuition_total_eur: EUR 5,412 for the non-EU non-resident population (45,10 EUR/ECTS x 120 ECTS = 5.412) (2026-27 rates). EU/resident first-enrolment comparison: 21,84 x 120 = EUR 2,620.80
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 (Decreto 45/2026, de 22 de junio, BOPA núm. 121 de 25-VI-2026)
non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit. The uniovi programme page publishes a separate table 'no residente Unión Europea' at 45,10 EUR/credit for 1ª, 2ª, 3ª and 4ª matrícula, i.e. the non-EU student pays the 2ª-matrícula rate from the first enrolment (21,84 -> 45,10, +106%). Decreto 45/2026 art. 1.2 authorises this: 'La Universidad de Oviedo podrá diferenciar el precio del crédito cuando se trate de personas extranjeras mayores de dieciocho años que no tengan la condición de residentes, excluidas las nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea ... el precio de la matrícula podrá cubrir hasta el 100% de los costes'. The reciprocity exemption list on the uniovi page (Argentina, Bolivia, Brasil, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Cuba, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guatemala, Guinea Ecuatorial, Haití, Honduras, MARRUECOS, México, Nicaragua, Panamá, Paraguay, Perú, Puerto Rico, Rep. Dominicana, Uruguay, Venezuela) does NOT include Tunisia — so a Tunisian applicant pays 45,10.
complementary_credits_required: TWO ANSWERS, both recorded. (a) FOR THE TITLE, from RUCT: 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' is not published for this title in the register (null in output/ruct-detail.jsonl) = NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT — not the same as 0. (b) FOR THE APPLICANT: the programme's own plan de estudios on uniovi.es lists two subjects flagged 'Complementos de Formación' — Matemáticas (4,5 ECTS) and Economía (4,5 ECTS), i.e. 9 ECTS of bridging built into the plan for students lacking that background. Neither the programme page, the master's own site (bellman.ciencias.uniovi.es) nor cei.uniovi.es states whether a 300-ECTS software-engineering graduate is exempted; that is decided by the Comisión Académica — NOT FOUND. Decreto 45/2026 art. 2.2: 'Los complementos de formación ... tendrán el mismo importe que el establecido para dichas enseñanzas' (so any complementos are billed at the same 45,10/ECTS).
application_window_2027: 2027-28 DATES NOT YET PUBLISHED. Recording the 2026-27 calendar with its year marked, not shifted forward: periodo ADELANTADO 9–27 February 2026 (matrícula 17–30 April 2026); periodo GENERAL 18 May – 19 June 2026; periodo EXTRAORDINARIO 3–31 August 2026 (listas 4 Sept, matrícula 14–16 Sept 2026). Regulated by Acuerdo de Consejo de Gobierno de 2 de febrero de 2026. A Sept-2027 intake applicant should expect the equivalent Feb-2027 adelantado round.
notes: RUCT code CONFIRMED two ways: printed on the university's own page as 'Código RUCT: 4315881', and the same code appears against this exact title in Anexo of Decreto 45/2026 (nivel de experimentalidad II). No conflict with the register. Note the programme is 120 ECTS / 2 years, unusually long for a Spanish master — this doubles the total cost and the visa duration. Two itineraries: Estadística Aplicada y Pública / Métodos Cuantitativos para los Negocios. 20 plazas. Language is Castellano only — a hard filter for an A1 Spanish speaker. Coordinator carleos@uniovi.es. www.uniovi.es serves WebFetch but timed out under curl; all facts here were read from the pages themselves, not a search index, except the periodo general dates (18 May–19 Jun 2026) which came from the search index summary of cei.uniovi.es/postgrado/masteres/preinscripcionymatricula — the fetched version of that page showed only the extraordinario block.

programme_name: Máster Universitario en Aplicaciones de Supercomputación y Aprendizaje Automático en Ciencia y Tecnología
official_status: máster universitario (official) — RUCT 3500887, estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA POR ACREDITACIÓN INSTITUCIONAL)', Nivel académico 'Máster - RD 822/2021', MECES 3; fecha de verificación 21/01/2026; BOE 24/06/2026 and 29/07/2026; Resolución Favorable Acreditación Institucional 26/03/2026
ects: 60 (RUCT: obligatorios 30 + optativos 12 + prácticas externas 6 + TFM 12 = 60; programme page states the same breakdown); 1 academic year
modality: Presencial ('PRESENCIAL' on uniovi programme page), taught at Escuela Politécnica de Mieres
language_of_instruction: 'Inglés' y 'Castellano' — the uniovi programme page lists BOTH as idiomas de impartición. NOTE a discrepancy worth flagging: the search-index summary of the same page reports 'English' alone; the fetched page shows Inglés + Castellano. Treat as bilingual, not English-only.
tuition_total_eur: EUR 2,706 for the non-EU non-resident population (45,10 EUR/ECTS x 60 ECTS = 2.706) (2026-27 rates). EU/resident first-enrolment comparison: 21,84 x 60 = EUR 1,310.40
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 (Decreto 45/2026, de 22 de junio, BOPA núm. 121 de 25-VI-2026; this title appears by RUCT code 3500887 in the Anexo under 'NIVEL DE EXPERIMENTALIDAD II' of másteres que no habilitan: 21,84 / 45,10 / 88,16)
non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit. The programme page publishes a separate 'no residente Unión Europea' table charging 45,10 EUR/credit for every matrícula (1ª to 4ª), against 21,84 for the first matrícula of Spanish/EU/reciprocity-country students: a +106% surcharge on first enrolment. Legal basis Decreto 45/2026 art. 1.2 (university may differentiate for non-resident foreigners excluding EU nationals, up to 100% of cost). Tunisia is not on the uniovi reciprocity exemption list (which does include Marruecos), so the surcharge applies to this candidate.
complementary_credits_required: (a) FOR THE TITLE, from RUCT: 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' not published for this title (null) = NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT. (b) FOR THE APPLICANT: the programme page states no complementos; its admission profile is 'egresados de grados de ciencias, ingeniería y disciplinas transversales', which a software-engineering graduate meets on its face. No applicant-level complementos rule is published — NOT FOUND (absence of a rule, not a stated exemption).
application_window_2027: 2027-28 DATES NOT YET PUBLISHED. 2026-27 calendar (marked as such, not shifted forward): periodo ADELANTADO 9–27 February 2026 (matrícula 17–30 April 2026); periodo GENERAL 18 May – 19 June 2026; periodo EXTRAORDINARIO 3–31 August 2026 (lista provisional 4 Sept, matrícula 14–16 Sept 2026). Central Universidad de Oviedo calendar, applies to all its másteres universitarios.
notes: RUCT code confirmed from the register detail row and independently from the Anexo of Decreto 45/2026, which lists '3500887 Máster Universitario en Aplicaciones de Supercomputación y Aprendizaje Automático por la Universidad de Oviedo' (the decree drops the trailing 'en Ciencia y Tecnología' — same title, same code). Only 20 plazas. Coordinator Alberto Otero de la Roza, oteroalberto@uniovi.es, Escuela Politécnica de Mieres. Of the three Oviedo targets this is the one whose language actually opens to a non-Spanish speaker, and it is 60 ECTS in one year — the cheapest and shortest of the three.

Acreditación 04/10/2016
ects: 90 (programme page: 'Número de créditos ECTS: 90'; RUCT: obligatorios 36 + optativos 12 + prácticas 12 + TFM 18 = 78 taught + 12 complementos formativos, total 90). 1.5 academic years
modality: Presencial ('PRESENCIAL'), Escuela Politécnica de Ingeniería de Gijón
language_of_instruction: 'Idioma de impartición: Castellano' (uniovi programme page). Spanish only — a hard filter at A1.
tuition_total_eur: EUR 4,059 for the non-EU non-resident population (45,10 EUR/ECTS x 90 ECTS = 4.059) (2026-27 rates). EU/resident first-enrolment comparison: 21,84 x 90 = EUR 1,965.60
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 (Decreto 45/2026, de 22 de junio, BOPA núm. 121 de 25-VI-2026; RUCT 4313659 listed in the Anexo under 'NIVEL DE EXPERIMENTALIDAD II' of másteres que no habilitan: 21,84 / 45,10 / 88,16)
non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit. Programme page carries a distinct 'no residente Unión Europea' table at 45,10 EUR/credit for all four matrícula levels vs 21,84 for the first matrícula of Spanish/EU/reciprocity nationals (+106%). Decreto 45/2026 art. 1.2 is the enabling provision. Tunisia is not on uniovi's reciprocity exemption list.
complementary_credits_required: (a) FOR THE TITLE, from RUCT: 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' = 12 ECTS — this title carries 12 ECTS of complementos built into its 90-ECTS structure (contrast the other two Oviedo targets, where the row is not published). (b) FOR THE APPLICANT: the programme page's plan lists seven Complementos de Formación subjects (Sistemas Tiempo Real, Automatización, Procesamiento de Imagen, Comunicaciones Industriales, Procesamiento Digital de Señal, Programación Algoritmos y Estructuras de Datos, Control de Procesos) from which a student takes the required load; the page does not publish which profile is exempted from which subject, so whether a 300-ECTS software-engineering graduate can be released from all 12 ECTS is NOT FOUND (Comisión Académica decides). CONFLICT on the per-subject size: the fetched programme page renders these seven subjects at 3 ECTS each, while the search-index summary of uniovi's 'Módulo de Formación Complementaria' describes subjects of 6 ECTS of which the student chooses 2 for a 12-ECTS module. Both logged; RUCT's 12-ECTS total is the figure to rely on. Note Decreto 45/2026 art. 2.2 bills complementos at the same per-credit price, so 12 ECTS of complementos = 12 x 45,10 = EUR 541.20 within the 4,059 total.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 DATES NOT YET PUBLISHED. 2026-27 calendar (year marked, not shifted): periodo ADELANTADO 9–27 February 2026 (matrícula 17–30 April 2026); periodo GENERAL 18 May – 19 June 2026; periodo EXTRAORDINARIO 3–31 August 2026 (lista provisional 4 Sept, matrícula 14–16 Sept 2026).
notes: RUCT code confirmed two ways: printed on the university page as 'Código RUCT: 4313659' and listed against the identical title in the Anexo of Decreto 45/2026. Registry estado is healthy (renovada por acreditación institucional) — not extinguishing. This is an automation/industrial-IT engineering master, path AC at best; it is Castellano-only and 90 ECTS. 20 plazas. Coordinators Antonio Miguel López Rodríguez and Diego Álvarez Prieto, EPI Gijón.
